notes.title: Hustle Simulator: The Road to Release
notes.content:
Bonjour, Steam Friends!

Big shoutout to all the wishlisters of Hustle! Quick heads-up: I'm sorry to report that our game's release has taken a tiny detour. We were aiming for May 2023, but it's now looking like May 2024 (fingers crossed it stays put this time!).

In the last fortnight, I've been like a coding ninja, weaving together all our cool game mechanics. It's starting to feel like a real game now, not just a jumble of code!

Fun fact: My 7-year-old gave it a whirl for a whole 10 minutes without any dad supervision. Kid-tested, parent-approved!

As for updates, I can't list them all (because, honestly, who keeps track?), but here are the highlights:

[list]
[*] Swanky new branding - Changed the game name from "Hustle: Business Simulator" > "Hustle Simulator" to better repersent the game better. Along with a new logo (I did myself, not sure if I like it, but I wont let that hult the progess of the game)
[*] Finally implimented A shiny start screen and menu system 
[*] What caused the delay - I figured out the A save and load system that actually works (I'm an indie dev, this is my first project!)
[*] Fixes galore at the Car Dealership, 'Pawn Shop' and Chicken Ranch. (because who doesn't love chickens?)
[*] Basically, I've turned a bunch of separate game parts into a cohesive gaming experience. You can start, play, save, exit, and load without a hitch. It's at least a 30-minute fun ride, or even longer if you're the adventurous type.
[/list]

We're not quite at the early alpha stage yet – need to beef up the mechanics with more stuff like buildings, levels, vehicles. You know, the works.

Stay tuned for an updated play test trailer coming your way super soon!

Thanks a bunch! 🎮👾🚗🐔
